props.text: Small shops, agencies that build stores for clients, and developers who want an e-commerce base they can read and change.
Install it on regular hosting, add your products and take orders without a monthly platform fee. Payment providers still charge their own fees.
Use the same free core for every client project. The MIT license allows commercial and client work.
It is a standard Laravel application. Write your own themes and modules, or change the code directly.
Install Modrix Commerce on your own hosting. Your products, orders and customers stay in your own database.
Start with the core, then add themes and modules such as payment providers, reviews, newsletters or flash sales.
Handle orders, pages and settings in one place. Staff roles, an audit log and scheduled backups are included.
Import the demo pages or follow the install guide.
